subject.title: fix(voice-call): persist assistant transcript on call.speaking events

question: Should this PR be narrowed to the voice-call transcript bug and have the boot-session memory changes split or dropped before review continues?
rationale: The central bug is real, but the branch mixes a voice-call repair with boot/session-state and security-boundary changes, and resolving the dirty branch requires maintainer ownership choices.

options.title: Narrow And Rebase
options.body: Keep only the focused voice-call transcript fix, preserve current boot/timer safeguards, and require redacted live proof before merge.

options.title: Split Boot Work
options.body: Move boot-run key, memory ingestion, host SDK export, and reaper behavior to a separate maintainer-reviewed PR with targeted security and upgrade proof.

options.title: Pause Until Proof
options.body: Leave the PR blocked until the contributor provides inspectable redacted real-call transcript evidence and conflict resolution.

recommendation.title: Narrow And Rebase
recommendation.body: Keep only the focused voice-call transcript fix, preserve current boot/timer safeguards, and require redacted live proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the current assignee and has recent history on the voice-call and Google realtime paths that define the central bug fix.
